name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
about: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (2005-029A, NASA/JPL), launched 2005 Aug 12. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.012 au and aphelion 1.688 au against GCAT's 1.013 and 1.682
